#include <iostream>

using namespace std;

#define S first
#define MP make_pair
#define all(x) (x).begin(), (x).end()

typedef pair<int, int> pair;

const int MAXN = 210;
const int MAXM = 2 * MAXN * MAXN;

template <typename T>
inline T sqr(T n) {
    return n * n;
}

struct MaxFlow {
    int to[MAXM], flow[MAXM], cap[MAXM];
    int lastEdge;

    vector <int> g[MAXN];

    MaxFlow() : lastEdge(0) { }

    void addEdge(int from, int to, int cap) {
        this->to[lastEdge] = to;
        this->flow[lastEdge] = 0;
        this->cap[lastEdge] = cap;
        g[from].push_back(lastEdge++);

        this->to[lastEdge] = from;
        this->flow[lastEdge] = 0;
        this->cap[lastEdge] = 0;
        g[to].push_back(lastEdge++);
    }

    bool dfs(int v, int T, int curFlow) {
        if (v == T) {
            return true;
        }

        for (int idx: g[v]) {
            if (cap[idx] - flow[idx] >= curFlow &&
                dfs(to[idx], T, curFlow)) {
                
                flow[idx] += curFlow;
                flow[idx ^ 1] -= curFlow;

                return true;
            }
        }
        
        return false;
    }

    int getMaxFlow(int S, int T) {
        int curFlow = 1 << 30;
        int resFlow = 0;

        while (curFlow > 0) {
            if (dfs(S, T, curFlow)) {
                resFlow += curFlow;
            } else {
                curFlow >>= 1;
            }

            for (int i = 0; i < MAXN; i++) {
                g[i].clear();
            }
        }

        return resFlow;
    }
};

MaxFlow maxFlow;

int n, t;
pair a[MAXN][MAXN];
pair b[MAXN][MAXN];

bool ok(int x, int y) {
    return 0 <= x && x < n &&
           0 <= y && y < n &&
           a[x][y].first != -1 &&
           a[x][y].first != -2;
}

void bfsDeath(int x, int y) {
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
            a[i][j] = MP(-1, -1);
        }
    }

    a[x][y] = MP(0, 0);

    queue <pair> X;
    X.push(make_pair(x, y));

    while (!X.empty()) {
        pair cur = X.front();
        X.pop();

        for (int k = 0; k < 4; k++) {
            int tx = cur.first + dx[k];
            int ty = cur.second + dy[k];

            if (ok(tx, ty) && a[tx][ty].first == -1) {
                a[tx][ty] = MP(cur.first, cur.second);
                X.push(make_pair(tx, ty));
            }
        }
    }
}

void runBFS(int x, int y) {
    queue <pair> X, Y, lev;
    memset(a, 0, sizeof a);
    
    a[x][y] = MP(0, 0);
    X.push(make_pair(x, y));
    Y.push(x * n + y);
    lev.push(0);

    while (!X.empty()) {
        pair cur = X.front();
        int curlev = lev.front();

        X.pop();
        Y.pop();
        lev.pop();

        if (isdigit(b[cur.first][cur.second]) && b[cur.first][cur.second] != '0') {
            maxFlow.addEdge(x * n + y, sqr(n) + 1 + cur.first * n + cur.second, 2147483647);
        }
        
        if (curlev >= t) {
            continue;
        }

        for (int k = 0; k < 4; k++) {
            int tx = cur.first + dx[k];
            int ty = cur.second + dy[k];

            if (ok(tx, ty) && a[tx][ty].first == -1) {
                if (dist[tx][ty] > curlev + 1) {
                    X.push(make_pair(tx, ty));

                    lev.push(curlev + 1);
                } else if (dist[tx][ty] > curlev && isdigit(b[tx][ty]) && b[tx][ty] != '0') {
                    maxFlow.addEdge(x * n + y, sqr(n) + 1 + tx * n + ty, 2147483647);
//                    printf("(%d, %d) --> (%d, %d)\n", x, y, tx, ty);
                }

                a[tx][ty] = MP(cur.first, cur.second);
            }
        }
    }
}

void build() {

    int posi = -1, posj = -1;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
            if (a[i][j].first == -2) {
                posi = i, posj = j;
            }
        }
    }

    bfsDeath(posi, posj);
    
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
            if (isdigit(a[i][j].first) && a[i][j].first != '0') {
                maxFlow.addEdge(S, i * n + j, a[i][j].first - '0');
            }
        }
    }

    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
            if (isdigit(b[i][j].first) && b[i][j].first != '0') {
                maxFlow.addEdge(i * n + j + sqr(n) + 1, T, b[i][j].first - '0');
            }
        }
    }

    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
            if (isdigit(a[i][j].first) && a[i][j].first != '0') {
                runBFS(i, j);
            }
        }
    }
}

int main() {
#ifndef ONLINE_JUDGE
    freopen("in", "r", stdin);
#endif

    scanf("%d %d", &n, &t);

    scanf("\n");
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        scanf("%s", a[i]);
    }

    scanf("\n");
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        scanf("%s", b[i]);
    }

    build();

    printf("%d\n", maxFlow.getMaxFlow(S, T));

    return 0;
}
